tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless & PWA Commerce APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud role at dormakaba. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: PWA Integration
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC Web Services for Headless Commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends.

bullets.label: Platform Customization
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: CCv2 Deployments
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.gap: While my background is primarily focused on backend and API integration for SAP Commerce platforms rather than dedicated frontend framework development, I am very keen to learn and expand my skill set in this area.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 (earliest start 16.12.2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience to dormakaba, supporting robust e-commerce architectures and integration workflows for a globally recognized enterprise.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and API integration expertise to support dormakaba's e-commerce initiatives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I applied for the Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud role. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in OCC APIs, headless commerce, and Java. Based in Germany with valid work authorization.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud position at dormakaba.

With over 5 years of professional experience working on enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) implementations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and headless integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my background matches your team's needs.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
